name: semantic-preserving bounded segmentation with capped crosscheck redundancy and hierarchical synthesis
purpose: Predefine how the historical evidence corpus is segmented, how large evaluator batches may be, and how compact batch results are hierarchically synthesized. Raw evidence is evaluated in isolated fresh processes and is never reintroduced after the batch layer.

heuristic.principle: Create small stable evidence units that preserve local meaning, then group them into bounded batches sized to keep a single evaluator request far below the model's input-token-per-minute ceiling.
preferred_boundary_order: JSON array/object member boundary when recoverable without changing source text
hard UTF-8 byte boundary only as a last resort
justification: File-level assignment previously allowed individual evaluator contexts to become pathologically large.
Approximately 120 KB segments are small enough to redistribute semantically while usually preserving multi-record local context.
A 180 KB primary-batch target leaves substantial headroom below the hard 240 KB ceiling and prevents the planner from operating near the quota-sensitive boundary.
A 240 KB hard primary ceiling keeps every fresh evaluator request far below the earlier megabyte-scale requests that exhausted the 2,000,000 input-token/minute quota.
Crosscheck batches are smaller because they are redundant evidence passes rather than primary coverage.
Base segmentation contains no overlap; every repeated raw byte is explicit crosscheck cost and is counted against the global redundancy budget.

batch_constraints.primary_batch_count_rule: The planner must produce at least ceil(D / target_primary_batch_bytes) primary batches and may produce more when semantic grouping or hard batch limits require it.
batch_constraints.primary_batch_size_rule: No primary batch may exceed hard_max_primary_batch_bytes. Before returning, the planner must sum size_bytes for every segment in every primary batch and split any batch above the hard limit.
batch_constraints.crosscheck_batch_size_rule: No crosscheck batch may exceed hard_max_crosscheck_batch_bytes. Before returning, the planner must sum size_bytes for every segment in every crosscheck batch and split any batch above the hard limit.
batch_constraints.crosscheck_rule: Crosscheck batches may intentionally overlap or redistribute already-primary-assigned segments, including deterministic or seeded stochastic selection, but all repeated raw bytes count against the extra 0.5D redundancy budget.

fresh_evaluator_isolation.rule: Every planner, primary batch, crosscheck batch, quarter synthesis, dyad synthesis, and final synthesis is executed in a newly instantiated Node process and a new Gemini request.
fresh_evaluator_isolation.batch_input_rule: A batch evaluator receives only the common audit instruction plus the materialized raw segments assigned to that one batch. It receives no other batch raw context, no previous model conversation, and no previous batch result.
fresh_evaluator_isolation.synthesis_input_rule: Synthesis evaluators receive only compact outputs from their direct child nodes and the audit objective. They receive no raw historical corpus and no model conversation from any prior node.

stage_1.input: all compact primary and crosscheck batch results
stage_1.partition_rule: Measure serialized result bytes and distribute results into four approximately equal groups using deterministic largest-result-first balancing into the currently smallest group.

synthesis_tree.compression_rule: Each synthesis node must remove redundant prose while preserving provenance identifiers, substantive facts, interpretations, truth decisions, requirement findings, implementation findings, contradictions, and unresolved ambiguity needed by its parent node.

evaluation_pipeline: fresh lead planner groups fixed segment IDs into primary batches and crosscheck batches using metadata only
validate complete primary coverage, batch size ceilings, and the global <=1.5D raw-assignment invariant before exposing raw evidence to any evaluator
materialize exactly one batch context packet
instantiate a fresh evaluator process and evaluate that primary batch exactly once
destroy that process and repeat with a fresh process for the next primary batch
repeat the same fresh-process isolation for every crosscheck batch
measure compact batch-result byte sizes and deterministically balance them into four quarter-synthesis groups
instantiate four fresh quarter-synthesis evaluators, one per quarter
instantiate two fresh dyad-synthesis evaluators: Q1+Q2 and Q3+Q4
instantiate one fresh final evaluator receiving only D1+D2 and the audit objective
persist the synthesis tree and final result
prohibited: recursive Gemini calls from within any evaluator
model-directed compute request loops that resend the same raw context
conversation reuse between batches or synthesis nodes
passing prior batch results into a later raw-evidence batch evaluator
passing raw historical corpus into quarter, dyad, or final synthesis
whole-audit restart after a later batch failure
implicit overlap not represented in the validated batch plan
